info.name: Atlassian Admin Account Label Info API

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the label to query.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of contents that are to be returned.

params.name: start
params.description: The starting offset for the results.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of results to be returned.

items.docs:
Returns label information and a list of contents associated with the label.

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to access the Confluence site ('Can use' global permission). Only contents
that the user is permitted to view is returned.
